ablation_execution_multiplicity.arm_reset: each arm and each seed starts from zero model and zero trajectory state; no state crosses arms
gate_predicates: primary adjusted p<=0.05 in at least two distinct non-null families
candidate mean loss is no worse than fixed SGD in every qualifying family
candidate adaptation lag is no worse in every shift family and strictly better in one
candidate operations and storage are non-inferior with a 5 percent margin
pure-noise null does not show candidate advantage

ablation_execution_multiplicity.matched_random_probability: exact candidate fit apply fraction computed before tune as p_num=sum(candidate_apply), p_den=number_of_fit_rows, then reduced by gcd; no tune-derived probability
ablation_execution_multiplicity.missing_rules: missing, nonfinite, censored, or incomplete trajectories fail the arm and cannot be imputed
ablation_execution_multiplicity.paired_statistic: for each seed and family, D=mean_stream(log((candidate_loss+1e-12)/(reference_loss+1e-12))); use the statistic_formula over independent seeds; two-sided primary and one-sided mechanism/adaptation
ablation_execution_multiplicity.reward_shift_control: not an arm; forbidden because shifted reward changes the estimand; any future use requires a new protocol identity
ablation_execution_multiplicity.statistic_formula: X_seed=-D_seed for candidate-better tests; z=mean(X)/(sample_sd(X)/sqrt(n)); p_two=erfc(abs(z)/sqrt(2)); p_one=0.5*erfc(-z/sqrt(2)); n<2 or sample_sd=0 is invalid unless every X is exactly zero, in which case z=0 and p=1

adaptation_metrics.aggregation: aggregate the mean stream lag per seed, then compare paired seed means; never scan across a shift or attribute later recovery to an earlier shift
adaptation_metrics.baseline: median of the 16 finite losses immediately preceding the change point; if fewer than 16 rows exist, metric is invalid
adaptation_metrics.censoring: if no qualifying pair occurs before next_shift or trajectory end, lag=segment_end-change_point and censored=true
adaptation_metrics.change_points: use only generator stream segments; no inferred change points
adaptation_metrics.primary_temporal_endpoint: mean per-seed adaptation lag after each declared change point
adaptation_metrics.qualification: candidate lag no worse than reference by two rows in every qualifying shift family and strictly better in at least one delayed-reward or drift family
adaptation_metrics.recovery_scan: search adjacent eight-row windows [k,k+8) and [k+8,k+16) fully contained in the current segment; first k with both means<=threshold wins
adaptation_metrics.zero_and_nonfinite: zero baseline is valid and yields threshold zero; empty, nonfinite, or negative losses fail closed

controller_transition_table.name: horizon-credit constrained update policy
controller_transition_table.pending_rule: all pending and previous fields are consumed, overwritten, or reset by an indexed row; undeclared state is invalid
controller_transition_table.rhs_evaluation: every right-hand side is evaluated from the pre-transition snapshot; updates are committed simultaneously in listed order

rows.order: reset all trajectory and pending fields before row zero; retain theta and dual_mu only across fit trajectories
compute prediction and finite half-squared loss before any write or action
if pending_valid, apply the complete recurrence using only pre-transition values; no credit on the first row
compute q_skip and q_apply from theta before mutation; fit uses exact 1/4 hash assignment and tune/assessment use locked greedy selection

apply performs exactly one fixed-rate SGD update; skip performs zero parameter writes; then processed_rows=processed_rows+1 and cumulative_apply_cost=cumulative_apply_cost+pending_cost; no hidden accumulation or replay
compute pending_reward=-pending_loss-dual_mu*(pending_cost-apply_budget) from the pre-transition dual snapshot, then publish every field consumed by the next row; undeclared carryover is invalid
after the final row loss, set q_current=0 and gamma=0, credit the final pending action, and execute no model action
append exactly one canonical counter row per observed row after action

controller_transition_table.terminal_rule: trajectory length is 256 rows; row 255 records loss and terminal credit only, with no model action

generator_roster.draw_policy: each row consumes every typed roster entry in ordinal order and repeat order; conditional semantics select, mask, or zero already-drawn values; redraw is forbidden
generator_roster.generator_digest_rule: SHA-256(canonical_json of stream_order, family_map, source_id_frame, draw_policy, draw_roster, streams, cohort_seeds, rows_per_trajectory)

delayed_reward_v6.draw_mapping: cue=rademacher(repeat=0) and cached at episode phase zero; unused_cue=rademacher(repeat=0) always consumed; z=normal12(draw_ordinal=2)
delayed_reward_v6.draw_order: cue, unused_cue, target_noise on every row
delayed_reward_v6.equation: 32 episodes of eight rows; cue cached at phase zero; y=0 for phase<7 else sign*cue+0.05*z; sign flips at episode 16

drifting_relevance_v6.draw_mapping: for i=0..7 u_i=uniform53(repeat=i) and x_i=2*u_i-1; z=normal12(draw_ordinal=1)

event_sensor_v6.equation: three drawn events are deduplicated by summing polarity; x0 is forced to (-1,+1) by row parity after all draws; y=(1 before row128 else -1)*x0+0.15*z

long_horizon_v6.draw_mapping: for i=0..7 u_i=uniform53(repeat=i) and x_i=2*u_i-1; z=normal12(draw_ordinal=1)
long_horizon_v6.equation: xi=2*uniform_i-1; y=sign(row)*ring_buffer(x0,row-32)+0.1*z with sign=+1 for row<128 and -1 otherwise; ring prefill is zero

sparse_signal_v6.draw_mapping: signal=rademacher(repeat=0); for j=0..14 activity_(1+j)=uniform53(repeat=j) and polarity_(1+j)=rademacher(repeat=j); z=normal12(draw_ordinal=3)

action_hash.tune_assessment: greedy argmax q with apply winning exact ties

hash_prng_transcript.canonical_json: UTF-8 JSON with sort_keys=true, separators=(',',':'), ensure_ascii=true, allow_nan=false
hash_prng_transcript.digest_encoding: lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256, 64 ASCII characters; digest fields decode to raw 32 bytes before framing
hash_prng_transcript.lp32: u32 big-endian byte length followed by payload bytes; payload length must be <= 2^32-1
hash_prng_transcript.source_file_bytes: UTF-8 without BOM, LF line endings, exactly one final LF; source digest is over exact bytes

transcript_schema.ordering: ascending draw ordinal; every roster entry is consumed exactly once per repeat; no conditional draws
transcript_schema.test_vector: compiler emits seed frame, initial state, first 12 raw outputs, first uniform53, first normal12, and first action hash for fit/sparse_signal_v6/4000/0

assessment_absence.rule: assessment files, rows, effects, and result payloads must not exist before tune lock and review authorization

lock_counter_control_schemas.schema_policy: all fields are required, ordered, typed, and unknown fields reject validation

operation_and_byte_algebra.numeric_rules: binary64 round-to-nearest-even; no fused multiply-add; left-to-right reduction; overflow, NaN, and infinity are fatal; operation counts exclude hash and PRNG unless separately named
operation_and_byte_algebra.operation_units: one multiply, add, subtract, compare, divide, min, max, clip, counter increment, parameter write, hash invocation, or PRNG draw counts one; no fused-operation credit
resource_invariants: one input row enters each update
replay bytes are zero unless the explicit replay arm is present
energy joules are absent until a privileged workload-specific receipt exists
operation counts and measured joules are reported independently

estimand.favorable_direction: mean(D_seed_f)<0 with bounded adaptation lag and non-inferior resources
identification: candidate and fixed reference start from byte-identical zero model state
each paired arm consumes the identical ordered stream and one row per observe
fit action assignment is deterministic from the sealed hash transcript
tune and assessment actions are deterministic from the locked policy
assessment seeds are disjoint from fit and tune seeds
controller state is immutable during tune and assessment
all losses are recorded before any model or controller mutation
estimand.name: paired complete-policy cumulative pre-update loss effect
estimand.scope: complete constrained update-policy trajectory including controller, model, and carryover state

stop_rules: stop immediately on any digest, source-byte, schema, or independent-review mismatch
stop on any nonfinite numeric value, overflow, undeclared state, or hidden draw
stop and close V6 if independent review rejects the exact frozen packet
stop and close V6 if synthetic qualification is not candidate under the fixed gate
stop before assessment if fit or tune lock is absent or invalid
stop before real execution if synthetic candidate or separate execution review is absent
stop before energy claim if privileged workload-specific trace and receipt are absent
retain no_candidate when any quality, adaptation, resource, statistical, custody, or energy predicate fails
